newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends quiet day firmer, Brent off highs.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends quiet day firmer, Brent off highs.

text.p: IPE May gas oil futures ended the day firmer on the back of a market led up mainly by NYMEX unleaded gasoline, brokers said on Monday.
But in light volume trade resistance at $165 proved too strong once NYMEX crude and gasoline came off the highs.
The prompt May contract last traded up $1.50 at $165 a tonne, off the intra-day high of $165.75.
Volume was light and dominated by crosses and EFP's.
"We looked to the upside after NYMEX opened and heating oil tried to hold the gains but failed," one broker said.
"It was a poor session....and feels like the start of a long slow summer for gas oil," he added.
May Brent crude futures came off the day's high as NYMEX crude lost ground after an upward surge on the opening. May Brent traded at 1643 GMT up 33 cents at $18.19 a barrel, off the high of $18.30.
"There's no fresh news and we are moving just on technicals. Resistance levels have proved too strong," another broker said.
